shots.headline: Успейте к звонку
shots.sub: Каждая пара начинается через десять минут
shots.scene: Monday 08:50 bell change on the Community College: students in faculty colours streaming along the paths to the main hall, the clock running, HUD visible, autumn trees and lamps on Medium

shots.headline: Составьте всю неделю
shots.scene: Sunday timetable board open (auto-filled, one class being placed), the valid cell highlighted green and one clash shown red with its reason

shots.headline: Откройте срезку
shots.sub: Ворота сокращают путь и число опозданий
shots.scene: The guide's gate step: the gold gate just opened between the bus stop and the main hall, the heat ribbon on that path turning from red to green, late chip dropping

shots.headline: Решите обеденную толчею
shots.scene: Lunch wave at 12:00: queue at the canteen, the hungry counter in the HUD and the board's lunch card (canteen too small at lunch, 'Move to …' a later slot); no purchase in frame

shots.headline: Хаос кампуса
shots.scene: A crisis card on the live day (fee protest on the quad with its two choices), students gathered on the quad behind it

shots.headline: Растите настоящий кампус
shots.scene: Zoomed-out diorama after the Liberal Arts Quad opened: new halls on scaffolding, a second canteen, a dorm, lamps and benches along the paths, the Science Campus plots still locked

shots.headline: Нанимайте, стройте, улучшайте
shots.scene: Staff sheet open with professors and departments (marshals, canteen crew, registry), an upgrade running in the corner, a hall being built in parallel

shots.headline: Превращайте оценки в престиж
shots.scene: Exam week closed: semester report with grades, prestige rising and the next-intake choice (Keep / Grow / Be selective); no rewarded-ad button in frame
